changed: The common plugin SDK gains an authenticated HTTP helper and the Odoo client uses it (ADR 0026 common-SDK amendment), in 5234025. New src/e_agent/sdk/http.py: PluginHttpClient(base_url, timeout, transport).post_json(auth, path, body, headers, allowed_codes, rejection_code) applies the AuthContext last (a caller Authorization header cannot override it), refuses before sending (HostNotAllowed) any path that does not start with a single '/', any merged or built URL whose scheme, host or port differ from the base URL, and a caller Host header; sends with follow_redirects=False; turns a 4xx into HttpRejected(status, code) whose code is the caller's rejection_code(parsed body) when that code is in allowed_codes, otherwise REJECTED, with a fixed safe_message; turns a 5xx, a redirect, a 2xx body that is not JSON, a timeout or a transport error into HttpAmbiguous with a fixed reason. The helper has no logger, and every exception is raised outside the handler of the underlying httpx or JSON error, so no header or body is kept on, or chained into, an exception. src/e_agent/adapters/odoo/client.py keeps OdooJson2Client's constructor and call() signature, OdooRejected and the ten allow-listed E_AGENT_* codes (now ALLOWED_CODES), the X-Odoo-Database header and the host target context; it re-raises HttpRejected as OdooRejected(status, code, 'Odoo rejected the request') from None, so executor.py is unchanged. dists/plugin-sdk/pyproject.toml gains the optional extra http = ['httpx>=0.28,<1']; dists/adapter-odoo depends on e-agent-plugin-sdk[http] and drops its direct httpx dependency; uv.lock adds the extra and re-points the Odoo dependency with no third-party version change. pyproject.toml: the contract 'Core packages do not import agent frameworks or provider SDKs' gains ignore_imports = ['e_agent.sdk.http -> httpx']; lint-imports keeps all 12 contracts and reports '(1 ignored import)'. scripts/check_wheels.py: the bare e-agent-plugin-sdk wheel must not install httpx, and the e-agent-adapter-odoo wheel must import e_agent.adapters.odoo.client, which proves the extra resolves. docs/design/principles.md: PR-08 names test_plugin_dependencies_are_the_common_base and PR-25 names test_http_never_echoes_credentials (status columns unchanged). New tests: tests/unit/sdk/test_http.py (33 cases: test_http_applies_auth_context, test_http_auth_context_wins_over_caller_headers, test_http_refuses_other_hosts over 7 paths with no request sent, test_http_refuses_a_caller_host_header, test_http_does_not_follow_redirects_to_another_host, test_http_4xx_is_rejection_with_allowed_code, test_http_4xx_without_a_readable_code_is_rejected, test_http_5xx_and_transport_errors_are_ambiguous over 500, 503, 200-not-JSON, connect error and timeout, test_http_never_echoes_credentials over 5 outcomes x Authorization and X-Api-Key with root logging at DEBUG, walking __cause__/__context__ and checking str, repr, args and vars of every link, test_sdk_imports_httpx_only_in_http_module in a subprocess over e_agent.sdk and its 8 other modules) and tests/conformance/test_plugin_dependencies.py (test_plugin_dependencies_are_the_common_base reads the 3 plugin distributions from dists/*/pyproject.toml entry points and their manifests' kind and contracts; test_dependency_check_fails_on_zero_plugins; test_dependency_check_reports_core_and_unbound_domain_dependencies; test_core_contract_exempts_only_the_sdk_http_module). Red first: test_http.py failed at collection (no e_agent.sdk.http) and test_core_contract_exempts_only_the_sdk_http_module failed (no ignore_imports); the dependency scan and its two pure-function tests passed on the existing tree, which a guard over an already-compliant tree must; its negative test is the evidence that it detects a violation. Two never-echo cases then failed because the test itself allow-listed the canary; the test was fixed to allow only E_AGENT_STALE. The existing tests/unit/adapters/odoo tests pass unchanged. Review fixes (e6ace64; fresh-context Codex review harness/state/1/reviews/1d.7b.json, verdict rework, R-1 to R-7, all reproduced before fixing): R-1 Blocker: httpx's INFO request line (reason phrase) and httpcore's DEBUG traces (response headers, malformed bytes) could carry an echoed credential; the helper now installs a filter on the httpx and httpcore.connection/http11/http2/proxy/socks loggers that drops their records while a ContextVar marks a helper request in flight, and other httpx use in the process logs as before. R-2 Blocker: a non-ASCII credential made build_request raise a UnicodeEncodeError holding the whole value; every merged header name must be an RFC token and every value printable ASCII (HeaderNotAllowed), and request construction errors are re-raised outside their handler as RequestRefused. R-3 Blocker: a 4xx body the old client could not parse (a list, a non-string name) had become KnownNoEffectError(REJECTED), skipping the executor's identity reconciliation; when the caller's rejection_code raises the helper now raises HttpAmbiguous, the Odoo reader raises on a non-dict body and on a non-string message or name (the old client raised only for a non-dict body or an unhashable name; a numeric name was REJECTED and is now ambiguous), and a non-JSON 4xx stays REJECTED as before. R-4 High: the credential now replaces a caller header of any case, and a base or merged URL with userinfo is refused (httpx would send Basic auth instead). R-5 High: Host from the caller or the auth placement raises HostNotAllowed; Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding raise HeaderNotAllowed. R-6 High: the dependency check reads optional extras and is tested through its reader on a synthetic tree. R-7 Medium: the plan edit had ticked the four 1d.8 checkboxes; they are unchecked again. New tests: 15 more cases in tests/unit/sdk/test_http.py (48 in all) and tests/unit/adapters/odoo/test_rejection_classification.py (5 cases); the existing Odoo tests are unchanged. The helper tests could not be watched red (the module failed at import before the fix), so each fix was mutation-checked instead: undoing it made its tests fail (R-1 4, R-2 4, R-3 4, R-4 1 and 1, R-5 5); the R-3 executor tests and the R-6 extras test were watched red directly. Full gate on 3993f19: 945 passed, 30 skipped; check_wheels.py passes on the same tree. Codex re-review (harness/state/1/reviews/1d.7b-r2.json, same reviewer, verdict rework): R-1 to R-7 fixed, no new code defect after probing for filter gaps (other httpcore loggers, concurrent tasks sharing context) and header-charset leaks; its one new finding, R-8 (High, contract), was the close bookkeeping still uncommitted at review time, closed by this handoff's commit and close-check. Retro (ENG-WORK-3): the credential or setting echo found by review twice (1d.5 R-1, 1d.7b R-1/R-2) is recorded as gotcha G-13.

rulings.ruling: PluginHttpClient holds the base URL, timeout and transport and takes the AuthContext per request, where the plan says the helper is 'built from an AuthContext': the Odoo plugin builds its client once in create_plugin, and an AuthContext covers one invocation
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a per-invocation wrapper object around the same post_json; no caller outside the Odoo client exists yet

rulings.ruling: A 5xx, redirect, non-JSON 2xx, timeout or transport error raises the SDK's HttpAmbiguous instead of letting the raw httpx exception propagate, because httpx.HTTPStatusError keeps the request with its credential header; the executor maps every exception other than KnownNoEffectError to UNKNOWN, so no outcome changes
rulings.cost_if_wrong: code that catches httpx exceptions from the Odoo client would stop matching; git grep finds none in src/ or tests/

rulings.ruling: A 4xx whose JSON body the caller's rejection_code cannot read is HttpAmbiguous; the Odoo reader raises where the old client raised (non-dict body, unhashable name) and also on any other non-string name or message, which the old client turned into REJECTED. This replaces the first-round ruling that every 4xx may be REJECTED, which review R-3 showed was unsound
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a malformed Odoo 4xx goes to reconciliation instead of a known rejection: one extra read-back, never a lost or duplicated write

rulings.ruling: docs/design/principles.md and scripts/check_wheels.py were added to the scope (amend-scope, recorded in the contract): the new checks are named in their principle rows, and the wheel smokes prove the [http] extra, which discovery alone does not import
rulings.cost_if_wrong: two table cells and two smoke strings

rulings.ruling: R-1 is fixed with a ContextVar-scoped filter on the library loggers rather than raising their levels, because a level change would also silence pydantic_ai's model-call logging for the whole process
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a filter on six named loggers; if httpcore adds a logger, its records pass until the list and the real-transport test are extended

rulings.ruling: Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding are refused along with Host (R-5): the helper owns the message framing, and a caller value could desynchronise it
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a provider that needs a caller-set framing header would need the helper to allow it explicitly

rulings.ruling: A request the helper refuses before sending (RequestRefused, HostNotAllowed, HeaderNotAllowed) is a ValueError that the Odoo executor maps to UNKNOWN, not KnownNoEffectError, although nothing was sent
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a reconciliation read for a call that never left the host: conservative, never unsafe
